extracted.intended_audience: Agency support/administrative managers and staff preparing OMB Circular A-44 management improvement reports (e.g., Directorate report authors and office heads)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing a Directorate/Agency management improvement and reports-reduction report in response to OMB Circular A-44, following prescribed criteria and presentation format, and documenting concrete cost-reduction and efficiency accomplishments. The task emphasizes documenting accomplishments across organizational units so they can be consolidated into the Agency report to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow established criteria for reporting accomplishments
rubrics_metrics.description: '...they did an excellent job following the guidelines with respect to the criteria established for reporting accomplishments as well as the format for presentation.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare each reported accomplishment to match the specific criteria set out in the guidelines (content, scope, measures) so items can be consolidated into the Agency report. Adhering to the criteria improves uniformity and makes the Directorate report useful to Agency-level compilation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the prescribed format for presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: '...as well as the format for presentation.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present the consolidated report in the format required by the guidelines—consistent structure, headings, and data presentation—to materially assist in preparing the Agency report to OMB. Follow any specified layout, sections, and submission conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document concrete efforts to reduce cost and increase efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: 'When we can demonstrate concrete efforts to reduce cost and increase efficiency in these areas, it substantially re-enforces our capability to defend what we have.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize measurable, concrete cost-savings and efficiency improvements in support and administrative activities. Provide quantification (cost saved, processes streamlined, workload reduced) and evidence so reported improvements strengthen justification for continued resource allocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregate accomplishments across organizational units
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Their accomplishments will form the core of the Agency report to OMB.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect and consolidate accomplishments from individuals and subordinate offices throughout the Directorate. Ensure contributions are documented so they can be integrated into the Agency-level submission; coordinate with those assembling the consolidated Directorate report to avoid omissions or duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize scrutiny of support and administrative costs in resource allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Support and administrative costs are always a fair subject for severe scrutiny within the resource allocation process.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize and clearly document improvement activities in support/administrative functions because these areas are closely examined during budget/resource decisions. Frame improvements in terms of defensibility and impact on resource justification.
